text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …All right, just about the same as before. My lap times are becoming more consistent.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Looks like my theory was correct… Okay, one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Hey, I changed my mind. Let's do some extra training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Give me something that'll exhaust me to my bones. Otherwise…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The fire in my chest just won't go out!
choice_data_list: We can put it out tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I continue to add on extra training until Narita Brian is satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No. It has to be now, or there's no point.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her it's more efficient to train after a rest than to train while her body is already tired.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Efficient? You sound like my sister.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch, fine. But that means I want something extra challenging tomorrow.
